summary: Full end-to-end testing of MEP Quiz. 21/21 pytest backend tests passing including least-loaded set assignment, 35-request concurrency burst, quiz integrity (no correct_option leakage, cross-set rejection), server-side scoring, duplicate answer 409, resume, admin JWT auth, participants search/sort, leaderboard order, CSV export, question CRUD & bulk import parser. Frontend Playwright pass at 390x844 (registration validation, valid registration -> /quiz, 20-question run -> /completion showing only thank-you text) and admin dashboard at 1600x900 (bad password -> error, login OK, all 4 stat cards render, participants tab search+sort, leaderboard panel, Questions tab with set-1 selectable and question-list visible).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: bcrypt hash is generated per-process at first request from ADMIN_PASSWORD env; fine here but seed_admin/DB-stored hash is NOT used (spec asks env-based admin, so compliant).

server.py register(): the least-loaded loop retries up to NUM_SETS times only if FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED returns nothing; if many concurrent registrations exceed NUM_SETS in-flight, some could 503. In this burst (35) it worked, but a burst > 20 concurrent transactions could theoretically fail — consider a small backoff/retry with sleep on empty row.
current_question(): calls finalize() when no more questions exist even if attempt was never answered; edge-case fine but worth noting.
CORS default '*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec (browsers will reject). Set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly in .env for production.
Registration: name regex rejects digits which is by design; but marketing/organisation names with digits will fail — confirm expectation.
phone validator normalises 91XXXXXXXXXX to last 10 digits; two users with '+91 9876543210' and '9876543210' become duplicates — correct behaviour but undocumented.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed participants; TestSetAssignment and TestConcurrencyBurst each call POST /api/admin/reset-attempts as needed. Question set 20 gets 2 extra imported questions from bulk-import test (non-destructive to seeded 20).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0` (serial required — several tests call /api/admin/reset-attempts). Concurrency burst uses aiohttp with 35 parallel POSTs. Full-run scoring test identifies its participant by email lowercase. Set 20 accumulates a few extra imported questions across runs — question_count assertion uses >=20.
